
```jsx
import { CxBackdrop } from '@chassis-ui/react'
// or
import CxBackdrop from '@chassis-ui/react/src/react/src/components/backdrop/CxBackdrop'
```

| Property | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **className** | A string of all className you want applied to the base component. | `string` \| `undefined` | modal-backdrop |
| **visible** | Toggle the visibility of modal component. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | - |
